statement: Versioned Raft snapshot checkpoint creation, durable publication, restart-read, and typed validation exist as new owner modules (src/raft/snapshot-checkpoint-constants.js, snapshot-checkpoint-format.js, snapshot-checkpoint-store.js) without modifying existing adapter files: a checkpoint for a file-backed SQLite partition replica seals envelope version, cluster identity, raft-group identity, state-machine entity kind/id, membership epoch, last-included index and term read from the sealed image's own watermarks, payload kind/version, payload byte length, and sha256 digest; the sealed payload provably excludes _raft_log and _raft_state while retaining _transaction_outcomes and state-machine rows; the partition apply path durably records lastAppliedIndex in _raft_state and creation fails closed with typed apply_watermark_divergence when applied and committed watermarks disagree or the applied watermark is absent; in-memory and memory-backed SQLite adapters get typed unsupported_adapter; partial, corrupt, truncated, stray-WAL, unsupported-version, unsupported-kind, foreign-cluster, foreign-group, foreign-entity, and stale-epoch inputs yield typed validation outcomes never advertised as recovery progress; proven by the deterministic guard scenario raft-snapshot-checkpoint-format (new guard tests plus the unweakened gated-compaction regression files) passing 3 consecutive runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The raft-snapshot-gated-compaction guard tests and the compaction-policy typed refusal stay byte-identical; this Quest adds sibling owner modules only and does not modify src/raft/sqlite-log-adapter.js, in-memory-log-adapter.js, compaction-policy.js, or committed-entry-guard.js.
No transfer, install, retention, or HMAC transport authentication in this Quest (S2/S3/S5 scope); creation, durable publication, restart-read, and typed validation only.
